records.label: Organization
records.definition: A business organization, distinct from its login accounts and people.

records.label: Account
records.definition: An application login identity; not proof of one natural person.

records.label: Person
records.definition: A natural person. No person-to-account identity is inferred from the supplied evidence.

records.label: Asset
records.definition: A physical asset, whose identity is distinct from source records describing it.

records.label: Case
records.definition: A recorded service or complaint case.

records.label: Document
records.definition: A business document or report with its own lifecycle.

records.label: Event
records.definition: A dated activity, visit or historical event.

records.label: Item
records.definition: A part, stock item or configuration reference.

records.label: Measurement
records.definition: A quantity with a defined or explicitly unresolved unit and calculation.

records.label: Manufacturer
records.definition: Equipment maker buying engines; distinct from a login account or current engine owner.

records.label: Service Case
records.definition: A complaint case concerning a submitted engine serial.

records.label: Service Account
records.definition: An account participating in service processes; person or shared-account interpretation is unresolved.

records.label: Service Document
records.definition: A report, request, work-order document or service guidance record.

records.label: Service Event
records.definition: An inspection, training, assignment or service-history event.

records.label: Engine Reference
records.definition: A physical engine reference; serial-to-physical-identity resolution requires evidence.

records.label: Invoice
records.definition: A billing record, not proof of current ownership.

records.label: Claim Line
records.definition: A claim line concerning an engine and part; source reconciliation is separate.

records.label: Stock Item
records.definition: An individually represented stock engine or part reference.

records.label: Inventory Summary
records.definition: A periodic stock count/cost summary with source and unit provenance.

records.label: Configuration
records.definition: A model/list configuration reference whose uniqueness and detailed business meaning need review.

records.label: Role Set
records.definition: A set of staff application role flags, not a login account.

records.label: Identifier Reference
records.definition: A lookup identifier whose relationship to physical assets requires validation.

records.label: Controlled Code
records.definition: A typed application code reference, distinct from an engine configuration.

records.label: Training Measure
records.definition: An entered training target/actual measure with unresolved formula or units.

records.label: Report Measure
records.definition: A reporting measure whose authority and calculation require validation.

records.label: Sales Measure
records.definition: A sales reporting source or measure, not automatically authoritative.

records.label: OEM company
records.definition: Equipment manufacturer in the company-name master. Company name is unique in the saved index; this is not a login account.

records.label: OEM login account
records.definition: Email login under an OEM company. Personal, shared plant and branch meanings are not distinguished by the application.

records.label: Simpson staff account
records.definition: Staff login with roles from limits. A matching email in an OEM login does not establish identity equivalence.

records.label: Staff role flags
records.definition: Boolean roles for a staff account, not monetary or workload limits and not final ontology access policy.

records.label: Physical engine
records.definition: Physical engine as a business concept. Neither a serial-only lookup nor one invoice row guarantees globally resolved physical identity.

records.label: Engine invoice record
records.definition: Invoice-master entry keyed by billed-to OEM company and engine serial. Billed-to company is not established current ownership; serial-first-match lookup is ambiguous.

records.label: Service ticket
records.definition: One complaint form about one submitted engine serial, under an OEM account with company copied at creation; actual creator is separate.

records.label: Ticket timeline event
records.definition: Historical application log linked by ticket ID. Ticket fields, not replayed timeline events, represent current application state.

records.label: Ticket comment
records.definition: Comment linked to a ticket; actor kind may require its stored discriminator.

records.label: Joint inspection report
records.definition: One report per ticket according to code review, DRAFTED or PUBLISHED. Edits overwrite; this is not revision history.

records.label: FOC form
records.definition: Form against a ticket with dealer, failure, part quantity and warranty claim information. Acronym is undefined; no documented direct JIR or replacement-approval link.

records.label: Engine replacement request
records.definition: Ticket-linked replacement request or details. Simpson/OEM replacement modes are documented behaviour, not validated policy.

records.label: Replacement engine dispatch
records.definition: Ticket-linked dispatch record holding the replacement serial, while the ticket holds the complaint serial. Not the physical engine master.

records.label: Advance engine dispatch
records.definition: Advance engine sent under an OEM account. No ticket reference is documented.

records.label: Advance engine number lookup
records.definition: Lookup reference, not independent proof of a physical engine or ticket relationship.

records.label: Failed-engine inward record
records.definition: Inward receipt/transport/condition record for a failed engine. Ticket association uses free-text references; no guaranteed ticket ID link.

records.label: Part replacement line
records.definition: Ticket-linked part line with free-text part/mode/scope/extra. Quantity is not stored here according to review.

records.label: Part description reference
records.definition: Description-only reference. No verified mapping to Simpson part numbers in claims or FOC.

records.label: OEM-entered claim line
records.definition: Entered/uploaded claim line under an OEM account. Not reconciled with SAP claim lines and not a guaranteed ticket reference.

records.label: SAP-imported claim line
records.definition: Claim data imported from SAP files. OEM is text; dashboards use this collection. No validated manual-claim deduplication or ticket link.

records.label: SAP float-engine stock item
records.definition: Individual stock engine from SAP with serial, condition, stock and amount. Serial alone does not prove identity across companies.

records.label: Monthly float-engine inventory
records.definition: Count/cost summary described as calculated from float-engine stock; currency and aggregation details remain unconfirmed.

records.label: Engine model product record
records.definition: Model with multiple list-readiness entries. OEM and list numbers are text, without a guaranteed join to company/configuration masters.

records.label: Engine model reference
records.definition: Active reference using the record ID as a model name; distinct from a physical engine or invoice row.

records.label: Simpson controlled code
records.definition: Active code list with COMPLAINT, DEFECT and ACTION types. Older code-list connections are not opened by the application.

records.label: Service bulletin
records.definition: Service guidance with company/model/list/plant cut-in information. Distinction from service information needs business review; text ordering is a defect.

records.label: Service information
records.definition: Same documented structure as bulletin with a different number field. No business distinction is inferred solely from schema.

records.label: Internal cut-in record
records.definition: Plant/list/defect/model cut-in record. Physical serial ordering and applicability policy are not confirmed.

records.label: Failed engine analysis
records.definition: Independent quality process per serial with named quality approval; not directly linked to tickets.

records.label: Failed part analysis
records.definition: Independent quality process per part number. Active schema is code-reported; saved sample has no fields.

records.label: ICA/CAPA quality record
records.definition: Independent defect-based quality record. Acronym expansion is unconfirmed; saved sample has no fields.

records.label: Infant-care engine visit
records.definition: Early-life engine inspection visit with entered customer/representative details, not a ticket-linked record or proof of current owner.

records.label: Export engine complaint tracking
records.definition: Independent export complaint tracking with text serial/codes/company references; explicit cross-connection lookups are reported by the review.

records.label: Workshop manual
records.definition: Model/OEM/list/version document with archive and approval fields. Latest release is not automatically approved or effective.

records.label: Workshop manual revision
records.definition: Code-reported revision with manual reference, version, release date and approval. No fields were observed in the saved sample.

records.label: FAQ entry
records.definition: Staff-editable question/answer without an approval step; not automatically verified guidance.

records.label: Knowledge-sharing document
records.definition: Uploaded topic/document reference. Business accuracy and continued validity require review.

records.label: Scheduled training course
records.definition: Scheduled course with model, dates and status. Requested-by account reference is code-reported but absent from current sampled fields.

records.label: OEM training booking
records.definition: Booking against a course, with freely entered participants and admin acceptance/rejection. Participants are not account references.

records.label: Training material
records.definition: Uploaded material; no guaranteed course/session linkage is supplied.

records.label: Standalone calendar event
records.definition: Calendar entry, separate from a scheduled course or training booking unless a reference is verified.

records.label: Monthly training measures
records.definition: Manually entered targets and actuals. Touchpoint/man-hour definitions and formulas remain unconfirmed; domain placement is provisional.

records.label: Staff performance period record
records.definition: Code-reported staff record by month/year; no fields were observed in the saved sample.

records.label: Engineer attendance record
records.definition: Staff/year attendance structure observed in metadata; detailed business interpretation is not supplied.

records.label: Legacy MIS fields
records.definition: salesCount/ticketsCount are documented as unused zero fields, not live business measures. Hardcoded chart denominators are not authoritative sales data.

records.label: Unused sales-data collection
records.definition: No application reads/writes reported and no sampled fields. Does not establish an authoritative sales source.

records.label: Invoice compound identity

records.label: Documented ticket statuses
records.definition: Application status values; no approved transition policy is inferred.

records.label: Workflow stages versus event labels
records.definition: 14 reported workflow-stage labels, 11 timeline-only labels and two unused labels. Not 27 sequential steps and not a fully verified transition graph.

records.label: Attempted one-open-ticket check
records.definition: Serial-only check for OPENED/REOPENED; races, admin submission and reopening can bypass it. Never assert guaranteed global uniqueness.

records.label: Unregistered serial path
records.definition: A missing invoice-master match can enter ENTER_ENGINE_DETAILS and send an alert. Missing metadata does not prove a nonexistent physical engine.

records.label: Ambiguous actual creator
records.definition: createdBy may contain a staff-account or OEM-account identifier. Do not pick an actor namespace or merge emails without evidence.

records.label: Historical ticket company
records.definition: Ticket company is copied at creation and can differ from the account current company; current company must not rewrite ticket history.

records.label: Documented fiscal year basis
records.definition: April–March fiscal year uses ticket creation date; replacement report uses this value rather than approval date. Timezone/boundary implementation remains unverified.

records.label: Documented elapsed-day metrics
records.definition: mttr/mttc are per-ticket whole days since creation to resolve/close and cleared on reopen. Do not treat field names alone as verified aggregate mean statistics.

records.label: Documented single JIR
records.definition: One JIR per ticket according to supplied code review; edits overwrite. Source index/record consistency is not independently verified here.

records.label: Documented FOC statuses
records.definition: Reported form statuses; acronym and intended business meaning remain unconfirmed.

records.label: Replacement serial lineage
records.definition: Old serial is on the ticket and new serial on dispatch. Neither updating the invoice master nor choosing the correct later-ticket serial is guaranteed.

records.label: Documented dispatch statuses
records.definition: Reported dispatch statuses used by the supplied example; source record coverage is not a verified current dispatch result.

records.label: Documented stock conditions
records.definition: Reported stock condition labels, distinct from availability and ticket status.

records.label: SAP and manual claims are not reconciled
records.definition: Dashboards use SAP claims; source collections are never deduplicated by current application code. No cross-source equivalence is asserted.

records.label: Documented controlled-code types
records.definition: Current active code types; old unopened code connections are not valid automatic fallback sources.

records.label: Cut-in comparison is not trusted policy
records.definition: Lexical serial comparison, inconsistent compared fields and first-plant-only logic are implementation limitations. Ordering and complete applicability must be validated before answering.

records.label: No verified effective-document selection
records.definition: Newest release, approval status and archive are separate. Do not equate newest with approved/effective or infer supersession.

records.label: Editable FAQ is not approved guidance
records.definition: No review fields; staff edits are not business validation of content.

records.label: MIS denominator is not live sales
records.definition: Unused zero fields and hardcoded sales do not provide live source-backed sales or verified performance metrics.

records.label: Participants are not accounts
records.definition: Participant names/details are entered independently; COMPLETED plus certificates implies attendance without an explicit attendance fact.

records.label: Documented role visibility, not access grants
records.definition: OEM: own tickets; company admin: company tickets; primary engineer: assigned tickets; approver: assigned approvals; admin/float manager/quality admin: all tickets. Exposed endpoints are defects, never ontology access entitlements.

records.label: Documented warranty calculation, not approved policy
records.definition: All three reported limits apply to ticket creation date; depot/dealer stock bypasses the check. Operators, month arithmetic, missing-value handling, label matching and physical-engine resolution remain unconfirmed. This is not executable policy.
